programme.title: Paranormal: Caught On Camera
programme.desc: A witch taunts paranormal investigators in a graveyard. A woman's late husband checks in on their sleeping baby and an erupting volcano spews lava and paranormal activity. (S8, ep 4)

programme.title: Ancient Aliens 8

programme.title: Deep Water Salvage

programme.title: Salvage Kings
programme.desc: Learning From The Best: Under the watchful eye of Uncle Ryan, Julien puts his operator skills to the test during a delicate and risky demolition job. (S1, ep 8)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Final Decision: Les reveals to Seth and Ashley whether he'll buy the new pawn shop, but his decision has bigger consequences than anyone could imagine. (S5, ep 2)

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: Bradford 1: David Dickinson's team are in Bradford. Tim is brimming over a Lalique bowl. Will David Hakeney let a vintage train set go to auction for the sake of a tenner? (S10, ep 20)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Ashley vs Rich: Ashley is not happy when Rich invades her territory in the shop and a pawn shop customer is caught abusing his girlfriend. (S4, ep 9)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: New Hire. Now Fire!: A roid-raging meathead threatens Seth's father; Ashley surprises everyone with a brand new hire. (S4, ep 10)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Seth vs Rich: Les orders Seth and Rich to clean up the whole warehouse, in order to make room for lots of new merchandise. (S4, ep 11)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Drop the Bomb: American Jewellery is celebrating its 30th anniversary and Les wants to put on a big party to enjoy this milestone. (S4, ep 12)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Total Meltdown: Les delivers some devastating news to the family. Meanwhile, Seth and Ashley scramble to put together an event to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the shop. (S4, ep 13)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Aftermath: Exploring the goings-on in the Gold family's huge Detroit pawn shop. Les shocks the others when he reveals plans to buy a new store. Is it a good idea? (S5, ep 1)

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Choose Your Wea-Pawn: A friend shows Rick and Chum a star-studded collection of photos, while Rick races for a chance to bid on a car once owned by a legendary actor. (S24, ep 31)

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Zigging and Zagging: Spencer drops into the shop with some tasty new finds, but will Rick bite? Plus, Chum and Rick meet up with a magician. (S24, ep 32)

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Alien Energy: From military radar to Navy aircraft, sightings of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena have become more frequent - leading to unprecedented acceptance of alien contact. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Close Encounters
programme.desc: In 1974, a Saskatchewan farmer reports seeing objects hovering in a field before they vanish into the ether. Connecticut citizens witness strange lights and a giant UFO in 1984. (S1, ep 13)

programme.title: UFO POV
programme.desc: Phoenix Lights: Expert Chris Rutkowski, home to the largest UFO research archive, sets the scene and explains an unexplained event. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Encounter: UFO
programme.desc: When your day job involves the oversight of missile silos, nuclear facilities or a military base, the last complication you want is a close encounter with a UFO... (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: Aswang, Crashed on Mars, and Giant Wolves: Explore the truth behind sightings of a dreaded Filipino creature, a possible landing site on Mars and a big bad wolf in Canada. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: Marble Mountain Bigfoot, Waldek Mine Whispers, and UFO Buzzes Jet: Examine possible Sasquatch footage, a man claiming to have heard the dead and an odd UFO incident above Nevada. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: ISS UFO Swarm, Yale Lake Leaf Monster, and Rat King: Tony and the team investigate signs of an imminent alien invasion, reports of a lake monster, and a super rat collective. (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: Legends Of The Pharaohs
programme.desc: Nefertiti, the Beauty Becomes Queen: Wife to King Akhenaton, Nefertiti's portrait bust - now located in Berlin - is one of the most well-known ancient sculptures in existence. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: Legends Of The Pharaohs
programme.desc: Tutankhamun, the Pharaoh with the Fabulous Treasure: The discovery of Tutankhamun's largely intact tomb in 1922 was arguably more significant than his short reign as a pharaoh. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Queens Of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: Queen Tiye: Examine the story of Queen Tiye, who - over 3,000 years ago - surpassed her rivals and inspired a religious revolution that changed Egypt and the world. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Queens Of Ancient Egypt

programme.title: Queens Of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: Cleopatra's Daughter: The story of Cleopatra Selene, the little-known daughter of Cleopatra and Antony, who witnessed her dynasty collapse but survived to become a great queen. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: Holy Riches: The legendary treasures of the Copper Scroll, King Solomon's mines and the Syamantaka Gem. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: New: Clash Of Ancient Warriors
programme.desc: Battle of Hastings: In 1066, William of Normandy decided to go to England to claim the crown of England - which ignited a war of succession on an exceptional scale. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: The UnXplained...
programme.desc: Secrets of Ancient Structures: Age-old ruins can stand with their true history seemingly erased by time - can modern research discover why these ancient structures were built? (S4, ep 2)

programme.title: The UnXplained...
programme.desc: Mysteries of the Vikings: The Vikings were infamous for being bloodthirsty, seafaring warriors - but historians are learning surprising new things about this Norse society. (S4, ep 3)

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The Sphere, the Prophecy Machine and the Canary: Examine claims Nostradamus predicted Hitler. Plus, learn about the canary resuscitator and a tiny object with the power to kill. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: Ufo Files 1

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: UFOs and the White House: Since World War II, the White House has been sending documents pertaining to 'Unidentified Flying Objects' - but what do they know? (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: UFO Files

programme.title: Cathy's Curse
programme.desc: 1977. Horror. Director: Eddy Matalon. Stars Alan Scarfe, Beverly Murray & Randi Allen. A young girl is possessed by the spirit of her aunt. Soon people begin to mysteriously die off.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: As the night draws to an end, Caroline Munro closes the Cellar Club with what is coming up next week.

programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: The Corvini Inheritance. 1985. Stars David McCallum & Jan Francis. An unstable security consultant puts his voyeurism to good use when his neighbour confesses to being stalked.

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: 1984. Thriller. Director: Robert Vincent O'Neil. Stars Cliff Gorman, Susan Tyrrell & Dick Shawn. Molly earns her living as a prostitute but a serial killer is targeting people in her profession.

programme.title: The Party's Over
programme.desc: 1965. Drama. Directed by Guy Hamilton. A controversial film of its time. A young American girl is caught up in the wild London scene. Starring Oliver Reed.

programme.title: Land of Contrasts - Glimpses
programme.desc: 1944. Factual. Short documentary film about the contrasting faces of Switzerland - from the Medieval Chillon Castle to the bustling city of Zurich.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Long Distance Ride. 1986. Jack explains the intricacies of the universal troop saddle and, on the longest day of the year, he watches endurance riding in the New Forest.

programme.title: They Fought the Few
programme.desc: This exclusive film focuses on the unlikely friendship between a British Spitfire ace and one of the Luftwaffe's star pilots. Includes interviews with German pilots who flew over England in 1940.

programme.title: Robin Hood Junior
programme.desc: 1975. Family. Directed by John Black & Matt McCarthy. Stars Keith Chegwin & Mandy Tulloch. A group of children band together to save Maid Marian who has been taken hostage.

programme.title: Let's Sing With Popeye
programme.desc: Made in 1934 screen songs animated short. Produced by Fleischer Studios. Director Dave Fleischer. The song featured in this cartoon was 'I'm Popeye The Sailor Man written by Sammy Lerner.

programme.title: The Black Arrow
programme.desc: Plot and Counterplot. 1974. Stars William Squire, Simon Cuff & Eddie Byrne. Sir Richard is nearly killed by one of his men. Meanwhile, a huge battle ensues at Lord Brock's castle.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Sir Lancelot's Banishment. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. When Sir Lancelot reveals that King Marhaus plans to kill King Arthur, he is banished.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Batman's Waterloo. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. With Batman still in his watery trap, Robin is left in the hands of King Tut. Will Batman be able to save them?

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: Backfire. 1954. Stars Roy Rogers, Trigger & Dale Evans. A payroll-carrying parson is ambushed; Roy and Dale suspect an impostor posing as a friend.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: Titan Goes Pop. 1964. Stars Don Mason, Lois Maxwell & David Graham. When pop star Duke Dexter pays a visit to Marineville, Surface Agent X20 decides to abduct the singer and take him to Titan.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Cuckoo. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Gessler's problem is compounded further when he receives a message demanding taxes Gessler hasn't collected.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Gunpowder Plot. 1956. Stars Robert Shaw, André Morell & Pamela Wright. Dan Tempest is tasked with securing extra gun powder from the Admiralty after a succession of pirate raids.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The May Queen. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Lord Donnington has died on a Crusade and the new young Lord is under the influence of Lord Blackstone.

programme.title: Highway to Battle
programme.desc: 1961. Thriller. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars Gerard Heinz, Margaret Tyzack & Ferdy Mayne. Before WWII, a German ambassador starts to rethink his Nazi allegiance, but is it too late to escape?

programme.title: North West Frontier
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: J. Lee Thompson. Stars Kenneth More, Lauren Bacall & Herbert Lom. In British India, a prince must be taken to safety across a rebel-held territory.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: 1963. Enjoy a brilliant performance from bass player and singer Heinz with Dreams Do Come True.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Rider on the Hill. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Gordon Glenwright & Delia Williams. After killing two outlaws in self defence, Chris receives a death stick, marking him to die at the next full moon.

programme.title: Went The Day Well?
